title.en: Aggregate demand and the consumption function

heading.en: What decides how much a nation produces?
heading.kn: ಒಂದು ದೇಶ ಎಷ್ಟು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಯಾವುದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?

hook.en: In the short run, when prices are fixed, firms produce only what people plan to buy. So to know a country’s output and employment we must first know its planned spending, called aggregate demand. The biggest part of it is what households consume.
hook.kn: ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲೆಗಳು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವಾಗ, ಜನರು ಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಯೋಜಿಸುವಷ್ಟನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಮೊದಲು ಯೋಜಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಅಂದರೆ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಅದರ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಾಗ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಉಪಭೋಗ.

objectives.en: Define aggregate demand and its components
Write the consumption function C = C̄ + cY
Compute APC, MPC, APS and MPS

narration.en: In the short run, when prices are fixed, firms produce only what people plan to buy. So to know a country’s output and employment we must first know its planned spending, called aggregate demand. The biggest part of it is what households consume.
narration.kn: ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲೆಗಳು ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವಾಗ, ಜನರು ಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಯೋಜಿಸುವಷ್ಟನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉದ್ಯಮಗಳು ಉತ್ಪಾದಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಮೊದಲು ಯೋಜಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ ಅಂದರೆ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಬೇಕು. ಅದರ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಾಗ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಉಪಭೋಗ.

body.en: Aggregate demand (AD) is the total planned expenditure on final goods and services in an economy in a year. In a two-sector economy (households and firms) it has two parts: consumption demand C by households and investment demand I by firms. Keynes argued that in the short run, with prices fixed, it is aggregate demand that decides the level of output and employment.

points.en: AD = planned spending on final goods
Short run: prices fixed, AD decides output

narration.en: Aggregate demand (AD) is the total planned expenditure on final goods and services in an economy in a year. In a two-sector economy (households and firms) it has two parts: consumption demand C by households and investment demand I by firms. Keynes argued that in the short run, with prices fixed, it is aggregate demand that decides the level of output and employment.
narration.kn: ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತಿಮ ಸರಕು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಮೇಲಿನ ಒಟ್ಟು ಯೋಜಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಎರಡು ವಲಯದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ AD = C + I. ಅಲ್ಪಾವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲೆ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವಾಗ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆಯೇ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇನ್ಸ್ ಹೇಳಿದರು.

title.en: On the board: The consumption function

narration.en: Watch how the consumption line is built from autonomous consumption and the MPC.

say.en: Consumption has a fixed part and a part that grows with income.
Here autonomous consumption is 50 and the MPC is 0.75. The white line is the 45 degree line where C equals Y.
Where the two lines cross, consumption equals income. This is the break-even point: saving is zero.
Below 200, people consume more than income, so they dissave. Above 200 they save.
The slope of the line is the MPC. Average propensity is total consumption over total income.

body.en: The consumption function is $C = \bar{C} + cY$. Here $\bar{C}$ is autonomous consumption (consumption at zero income) and c is the marginal propensity to consume, $MPC = \Delta C/\Delta Y$, with 0 < c < 1. The average propensity to consume is $APC = C/Y$. Since income is either consumed or saved, $S = Y - C = -\bar{C} + (1-c)Y$. So $MPC + MPS = 1$ and $APC + APS = 1$. APC can exceed 1 at low incomes, but MPC always lies between 0 and 1.

narration.en: The consumption function is C = \bar{C} + cY. Here \bar{C} is autonomous consumption (consumption at zero income) and c is the marginal propensity to consume, MPC = \Delta C/\Delta Y, with 0 < c < 1. The average propensity to consume is APC = C/Y. Since income is either consumed or saved, S = Y - C = -\bar{C} + (1-c)Y. So MPC + MPS = 1 and APC + APS = 1. APC can exceed 1 at low incomes, but MPC always lies between 0 and 1.
narration.kn: ಉಪಭೋಗ ಫಲನ C = C̄ + cY. C̄ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ಉಪಭೋಗ, c ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಭೋಗ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ (MPC = ΔC/ΔY). ಸರಾಸರಿ ಉಪಭೋಗ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ APC = C/Y. ಉಳಿತಾಯ S = Y − C. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ MPC + MPS = 1 ಮತ್ತು APC + APS = 1. ಕಡಿಮೆ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ APC 1 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ MPC ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ 0 ಮತ್ತು 1 ರ ನಡುವೆ.

caption.en: A consumption function is a straight line: intercept C̄ and slope MPC.

narration.en: Use the graph plotter as a consumption function. The intercept is autonomous consumption and the slope is the MPC.

tryThis.en: Set the line y = 0.8x + 40. What are C̄ and the MPC?
Make the slope 0.9. Is the line steeper or flatter?

caption.en: C = C̄ + cY (yellow), the 45° line (white) and saving S = −C̄ + (1 − c)Y (green). Move the sliders.

narration.en: Change autonomous consumption and the MPC, and watch the break-even point and the saving line move.

tryThis.en: Set C̄ = 50 and MPC = 0.75. Check that break-even income is 200.
Lower Y below break-even. What happens to APS? (it becomes negative: dissaving)
Raise the MPC. Does the saving line get steeper or flatter?

problem.en: The consumption function of an economy is C = 100 + 0.8Y (₹ crore). Find consumption, saving, APC and APS when income is ₹1,000 crore. Also state MPC and MPS.

answer.en: C = ₹900 crore, S = ₹100 crore, APC = 0.9, APS = 0.1, MPC = 0.8, MPS = 0.2.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the PUC board, CBSE and CUET pattern.

points.en: Aggregate demand is planned spending: AD = C + I in a two-sector economy.
points.kn: ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಯೋಜಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ಎರಡು ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ AD = C + I.

points.en: The consumption function is C = C̄ + cY; c is the MPC.
points.kn: ಉಪಭೋಗ ಫಲನ C = C̄ + cY; c ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಭೋಗ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ.

points.en: At break-even income, C = Y and saving is zero.
points.kn: ಸಮಚ್ಛೇದ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ C = Y, ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಶೂನ್ಯ.

homework.en: For C = 40 + 0.75Y, find break-even income and APC at Y = 400.

narration.en: Recap. Aggregate demand is planned spending: AD = C + I in a two-sector economy. The consumption function is C = C̄ + cY; c is the MPC. MPC + MPS = 1 and APC + APS = 1. At break-even income, C = Y and saving is zero.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮಗ್ರ ಬೇಡಿಕೆ ಯೋಜಿತ ವೆಚ್ಚ: ಎರಡು ವಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ AD = C + I. ಉಪಭೋಗ ಫಲನ C = C̄ + cY; c ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉಪಭೋಗ ಪ್ರವೃತ್ತಿ. MPC + MPS = 1 ಮತ್ತು APC + APS = 1. ಸಮಚ್ಛೇದ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ C = Y, ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಶೂನ್ಯ.
